short: @zurfur/ui: the component library and its gallery
is: @zurfur/ui — a private SvelteKit library of components, consumed by `web` as TypeScript source, with a component gallery (its routes) prerendered by adapter-static and served on loopback by `just gallery`.
conventions: Consumed as source, no package step: `exports` gives `types` and `svelte` the same entry, `src/lib/index.ts`, and adds `./styles` (the side-effect styles entry, `src/lib/styles/index.ts`), `./tokens.json` and `./tokens.additions.json`; the version stays `0.0.0` and `web` depends on exactly that. Routes import the library only as `@zurfur/ui`, `@zurfur/ui/styles` or one of the two token files; `$lib` is banned in this package, since it would resolve to the importer's `src/lib`.

Plain client-side SvelteKit, nothing server-side: the gallery is prerendered (adapter-static, `strict`), files that run server code (`+server`, `.server.`, hooks) are refused by a check, and `vite.config.ts` may not rename them (no Kit `files`, no service worker, no svelte config file).

`eslint.config.js` partitions `src/` into file sets (checks, routes, gallery, storage, motion, lazy, and the components' rules for every other file) and runs with `noInlineConfig`, so no inline comment switches a rule off. The sets form three tiers, what ships (components, motion, lazy) < the gallery host (routes, gallery, storage) < the checks and specs, and a relative import never reaches a looser tier or leaves `src/`. A relative import of a file that is neither code nor CSS counts as the loosest tier unless it ends in exactly `?raw` or `?url`. A check holds `src/` to plain files and real folders (no symlink, FIFO, socket or device, and `src/` itself a real folder, all read without following links) and no `node_modules` folder, and refuses any file whose extension is off the list (`.ts`, `.svelte`, `.css`), except a folder's `NODE.inf.json`, `src/app.html` and the two token files `src/lib/styles/tokens.json` and `src/lib/styles/tokens.additions.json` by exact path: no other `.json` or `.html` file. No source file outside the checks names `fetch` or holds a remote URL or a `javascript:` URL in a string, and no component's markup holds a `<script>`, `<iframe>`, `<frame>`, `<object>` or `<embed>` element in any letter case, a `srcdoc` attribute, a `<svelte:element>` naming one of them by a static string, or an inline event handler: on an HTML element or a `<svelte:element>`, an `on…` attribute is allowed only in lower case with one expression as its value, which Svelte attaches as a listener (a component's props and a spread are not checked); the gallery's one boot script lives only in `src/app.html`, which ESLint never reads. The `storage` set holds only `src/gallery/skin-store.ts`, which may use `localStorage` and nothing else; every other file refuses all storage and `cookie`. The host may import exactly `@zurfur/ui`, `@zurfur/ui/styles`, `@zurfur/ui/tokens.json` and `@zurfur/ui/tokens.additions.json`. `{@html}`, `bind:innerHTML` and the raw-HTML DOM calls (`innerHTML`, `outerHTML`, `insertAdjacentHTML`, `setHTMLUnsafe`, `createContextualFragment`, `document.write`) are refused everywhere. The network scan refuses a non-relative `@import` and any scheme but `data:` in CSS, and reads the page shell as a browser does (braces as text, each script parsed and its strings checked). Lint guards against accidental coupling, it is not a sandbox.
`just gallery` serves on 127.0.0.1 at `ZURFUR_GALLERY_PORT` or 5190 (`vite.config.ts` alone decides host and port; a busy port is an error).
Installs only through the workspace's guarded trio (`just frontend-install`), never a bare `yarn install` here.

`node src/checks/built-output.ts build` runs after every ui build, in `just gate`, `just gate-light` and CI's `ui` job: it refuses remote URLs in the built CSS and HTML (exit 0 clean, 1 findings, 2 unreadable).
The token files are never edited by hand: `yarn tokens:copy <version>` recopies the design system's file, `yarn tokens` regenerates `tokens.css` (see `src/lib/styles`).

fs.name: .gitignore
fs.role: ignores this package's build output (.svelte-kit/, build/) and .env*

fs.name: .prettierignore
fs.role: lockfiles, static/, NODE.inf.json files (the nodes tool formats those), the token files (tokens.json, tokens.css) and src/app.html (pinned by hash) are not formatted

fs.name: eslint.config.js
fs.role: type-aware lint with the file-set partition of src/ (storage set included), the boundary rules and three package rules (ui/import-tiers: no relative import into a looser tier or out of src/, and a relative import of a file that is neither code nor CSS counts as the loosest tier unless it ends in exactly ?raw or ?url; ui/no-remote-string: no http:, https: or protocol-relative string; ui/no-script-url: no javascript: string); the boundary syntax bans also refuse markup that runs script or loads another document, inline event-handler attributes included; exports boundaryRules, fileSetOf, scriptMarkupMessage and inlineHandlerMessage for the checks

fs.name: package.json
fs.role: @zurfur/ui 0.0.0: the exports map (the library entry, ./styles, ./tokens.json, ./tokens.additions.json), yarn scripts (dev/build/preview/check/lint/test, tokens and tokens:copy) and the dependencies (the two Atkinson Fontsource packages) and dev dependencies; svelte is a peer

fs.name: prettier.config.js
fs.role: tabs, single quotes, no trailing comma, width 100

fs.name: src/
fs.role: the library, the gallery frame, the gallery routes and the repo-shape checks

fs.name: tsconfig.json
fs.role: strict + noUncheckedIndexedAccess + exactOptionalPropertyTypes + erasableSyntaxOnly, kept equal to web's by a check

fs.name: vite.config.ts
fs.role: adapter-static (strict), runes forced outside node_modules, the $gallery alias, 127.0.0.1 server and preview on the gallery port with strictPort, and the three vitest projects (browser by *.svelte.spec.ts, node for the rest, and client-media: the one media spec with the emulateMedia command, run after the others)
